$comment: Sort UI 2.0 Date Picker demos (page 340:2): Figma has no Date Picker component set, so the references are two demo frames, exported at 1x with their absolute bounds (240 × 368, the calendar's shadow left out): "Date Picker" (a Field labelled "Review due", an Outline Button trigger and the Calendar panel open on March 2026, the 27th picked, today the 17th) and "Input" ("Subscription date": an Input with a ghost calendar button, the Calendar open on September 2026, the 20th picked). renderers/date-picker.tsx renders the same open pickers in a 240 × 368 box. No spec.json: the trigger, input and calendar are checked by their own components.
